First off - thank you all for honoring the Sabbath. I understand there were still some posts, and some people got upset about it, but I was fine with everything posted. The age of creation has ended and we now enter the age of mortals (races). There are still plenty of kinks to work out and I appreciate the community's levelheadedness and patience. Let's go over some Meta things.

**Me and my duties** I can't do this full time, barely part time. You might get an hour a day out of me. If someone would like to take my place as DM and I can be a mere god, that's fine - just PM me. This game is moving faster than I expected and even as I type this I am attempting to keep my screaming baby from rolling into some wires. I also mainly access voat via my phone, so sitting down and making posts like this is very difficult during the weekdays (and weekends always have some chore lined up for me as well). I want to be the DM you deserve, but I simply cannot dedicate as much of my time to this and for that I am sorry.

**New Players** You cannot be a god any longer. Our pantheon is set and vast, but you can still play. You can play as already existing races or request a race be made. If you would like an existing race, you can post [Claim race] then the race's name in a post. If you would like to request a race post [Race request]. You can either add suggestions for said race, or be totally at the mercy of a god. If you want a certain god - make sure to tag them in the comment section. If you like surprises, you can be at the mercy of any god to create any race.

**Creations/Races** Creations will now work like actions - requiring a aye/nay vote and 24 hours to be approved. Now is the time for races as our world is mostly shaped. Unclaimed races will be at the mercy of all gods. Claimed races may take suggestions/actions from gods instead.

**Relinquishing godhood** Should a god feel the need, they may relinquish godhood and become a race/mortal/monster. They can create said mortals and relinquish godhood in the same post, just tag it [Relinquish]. This can trim our pantheon and create more races without having to rely too much on new players. Godhood can be reclaimed by the same player in the event that their mortal(s) die.

**Joining v/all/** I personally think we should stay off for a while, but I'll take a vote on this one.

Let me know if I forgot anything!
